_why.TIME_WARP_GAMMA: 1.5 slows the pm rush (3:42 to 5:25 per eighth) and cuts midnight to 5 am to 3.3 s without a faster peak rate
_why.CARD_LINES: line 2 is two short lines that read at a glance; the trains video after it opens on line 1
_why.OUTSIDE_DIM: 0.75 drops Mississauga and York Region to a faint hint, so Toronto reads 4.2x brighter than its neighbours (b: 2.9x)
_why.day.TRAIL_MINUTES: 18 min draws the red grid as thin lines, strobe 0.0153 to 0.0147, corridors still apart, whiteout 0.011
_why.TRAIL_SHOULDER_W: 8 px trims the glow round the downtown streetcars; lines stay legible, dots stay sharp, strobe unchanged
_why.day.BUS_CORE_R: 1.6 px dots still read at night and cut strobe 0.0148 to 0.0092; the peak stops being a white dot carpet
_why.rush.TRAIL_MINUTES: 9 min joins the streetcar and bus lines downtown into thin threads, strobe 0.0145 to 0.0141, no fusing
_why.rush.BUS_CORE_R: the day's 1.6 px dots, set by hand (no rush dot knob): strobe 0.0141 to 0.0084, no white dot carpet after VP9
